1.explanation: This example wraps a Grommet Tabs in a Box with a fixed height ("medium") and scrollable overflow. Each Tab contains enough lines to require scrolling. In grommet@2.25.0 + grommet-theme-hpe@3.2.0 you will see that when you scroll within the tab panel, the active Tab’s underline (which normally sits at the very bottom of the header area) shifts upward and no longer aligns with the Box’s bottom border.
1.bug_scenario: When you render a Grommet Tabs component inside a fixed-height, scrollable container (using grommet-theme-hpe), as you scroll the content inside the active Tab, the underline indicator of the selected tab no longer stays glued to the bottom of the Tabs header. Instead, it floats up mid-header, leaving a gap between the underline and the container's bottom border. This did not happen in grommet@2.24.0 but appears in 2.25.0 after PR #6137.
